lines: Start City. Last continent, first stop. The portal train does not go back on its own. You have to choose to go back, and you have not finished here yet.
npcs.speaker: Portal-train conductor

lines: This is the last continent. Not the last story. The Liberation Front is here, in full, and they are not hiding anymore.
npcs.speaker: Start City elder

entries.sprites: portal station + city, Kenney Tiny City CC0 restyled

entries.kind: researcher's town, first route, no dojo (shape label, not a new place name)

lines: The last continent has its own first route. Walk it like it is your first route ever, and you will see what the other routes hid.
npcs.speaker: Town researcher

lines: First wilds, last continent. The grass here is new, but the lesson is old: catch, raise, and do not rush.
npcs.speaker: Route keeper

entries.sprites: research town, Tiny Town CC0 restyled

lines: We do not want to own the Mochiichao. We want to free them. From you. From everyone. Even from the Mainframe itself.
antagonist.speaker: Liberation Front speaker, rally

entries.kind: media city, Front rally, no dojo (shape label, not a new place name)

lines: The Front is on every screen here. That is not news. That is a rally, and a rally is not the same as a conversation.
npcs.speaker: Media clerk

lines: Listen to them, then listen to your team. Your team has been with you longer than any speech. That matters, and it is not a slogan.
npcs.speaker: City elder, after the rally

entries.sprites: media city, Kenney Tiny City CC0 restyled

post: Work. Take the first badge of this region.
pre: A mining dojo is a dojo of work. Show me work, not wishes, on the last continent too.

lines: The last continent's mine is the same work, new rock. Work is work, wherever you dig it.
npcs.speaker: Mine keeper

entries.sprites: mining city, Tiny City CC0 restyled + 0x72 CC0

lines: The valley here is not the valley in Region 4. Same flowers, different soil. Soil matters.
The Front walked through here too. They left pamphlets, not footprints. Pamphlets fade. Footprints do not.
npcs.speaker: Flower keeper

entries.sprites: flower valley, Kenney Tiny Town CC0 restyled

pre: A forest dojo is a dojo of patience. Trees do not hurry, and neither do I, on any continent.

lines: The forest here is younger than Region 4's forest, and younger is not weaker. Young trees bend, and bending is a skill.
npcs.speaker: Forest keeper

entries.sprites: forest city, Tiny Town CC0 restyled

pre: A contest dojo is a dojo of grace. Grace is not soft. Grace is exact, under lights, on the last continent too.

lines: The contest here is the same showing, new lights. Show your creature, and show it kindly.
npcs.speaker: Contest hall keeper

lines: The Garden branch here is the same Garden, newest soil. Raise them here, and they will remember every garden before this one.
npcs.speaker: Mochiko, Garden branch

entries.sprites: contest hall, Kenney Furniture Kit CC0 restyled

lines: We are freeing creatures, not stealing them. If you cannot tell the difference, you are part of the problem we are solving.
antagonist.speaker: Liberation Front operative, warehouse

pre: A warehouse dojo is a dojo of strength with nowhere to hide. Stand in the open, even when the Front is watching.

lines: The warehouses here are full of Front supplies. Supplies are not arguments. Arguments are what you say after you open the warehouse.
npcs.speaker: Warehouse keeper

lines: The frozen one does not want a Ranger. It wants to be free, and free means cold, and cold means alone. We are helping it be alone.
antagonist.speaker: Liberation Front operative, cold corner

post: You waded. Take the fifth badge.
pre: A marsh dojo is a dojo of patience in wet boots. Wade, and do not complain about wet, even when the water is cold.

entries.kind: Dojo 5, marsh city, preserve, frozen plot start

lines: The marsh here is a preserve, same rule: look, learn, do not take more than the marsh offers.
npcs.speaker: Marsh keeper

lines: Something frozen is in the marsh's cold corner, and the Front is interested in it. Cold is not the same as dead. Remember that.
npcs.speaker: Preserve guide, frozen plot

entries.sprites: marsh + preserve, Tiny Town CC0 restyled

lines: This town is old on the last continent, which means it is older than the continent's story admits. Old towns do not lie. New stories do.
npcs.speaker: Lore keeper

lines: The bond is the story here. Not the battle, not the badge. The bond. Ask your team what it wants, and listen to the answer.
npcs.speaker: Celestic elder

entries.sprites: old town, Tiny Town CC0 restyled

lines: The book is old. Old books are not truth. They are just old. We are new, and new is better, because new has not failed yet.
antagonist.speaker: Liberation Front speaker, library steps

pre: A port dojo is a dojo of steel and salt. Rust is honest. Be honest, and be steel, even when the story gets cold.

entries.kind: Dojo 6, port, library, frozen plot escalates

lines: The library here has a book about the frozen one. It does not say what the Front says it says. Read it yourself. That is the whole job.
npcs.speaker: Library keeper

entries.sprites: port + library, Tiny City CC0 restyled

post: You waited. Take the seventh badge.
pre: Snow does not hurry. Snow waits, and then it is everywhere. Be snow, even in a frozen plot.

entries.kind: Dojo 7, snow city, temple, frozen plot

lines: The temple is cold, and the frozen one is colder. Cold is not evil. Cold is just cold. The Front is making cold into a story, and stories can freeze people too.
npcs.speaker: Temple keeper

entries.sprites: snow city + temple, Tiny Town CC0 restyled

post: You stood. Take the eighth badge.
pre: A solar dojo is a dojo of light with no shadows to hide in. Stand in the light, after all the cold and all the marsh.

lines: The city runs on sun, even on the last continent. Sun is free, and free is not the same as easy. Keep the panels clean, and keep your team cleaner.
npcs.speaker: Solar keeper

entries.sprites: solar city, Kenney Tiny City CC0 restyled

lines: Eight badges, all five regions in one route. That is the gate. Walk it. Rangers from every region you have walked are here, and they remember you.
npcs.speaker: Victory gate keeper

lines: I walked with you in Region 1, and I walked against you in Region 4. Now I walk here. Show me the whole journey, not just the last town.
After battle: Whole. Good. The Plateau is next, and it is the whole journey too.
npcs.speaker: Veteran Ranger, mixed-region team (ROSTER GAP)

post: You beat the continent. Now beat the game. The Grand Tournament is waiting, and Mythar is waiting after it.
pre: You beat the continent. Now beat the Ranger the continent remembers most.
champion.speaker: CHAMPION — Bannon

pre: I guard the door. The bond taught me that a door is not a wall, if you knock right.
elite.speaker: ELITE 1 (NAME GAP)

pre: I guard the stairs. The frozen plot taught me that cold is not the same as closed.
elite.speaker: ELITE 2 (NAME GAP)

post: It remembers you. The champion's door is next.
pre: I guard the hall. The hall remembers every region, every bond, every battle.
elite.speaker: ELITE 3 (NAME GAP)

pre: I guard the champion's door. Knock twice, and mean it, for all five regions at once.
elite.speaker: ELITE 4 (NAME GAP)

entries.music: elite loop, champion loop, hall loop calm, CC0 chiptune

lines: Fifth ascent. The Hall has a fifth page for you, if you earn it. After that, the Hall has a final page, and it is not yours yet.
npcs.speaker: Plateau attendant

entries.sprites: Plateau + Hall, Furniture Kit CC0 restyled

post: You beat me here too. Good. Mythar is next. Do not let the bracket fool you — Mythar is not a bracket. Mythar is a final.
pre: I am here too. Not as your rival this time. As a champion, in a bracket. Beat me here, and the bracket means more.

lines: Welcome to the Grand Tournament. Every champion, every region, one bracket. Win it, and you face Mythar.
npcs.speaker: Tournament announcer

lines: Leaders and champions from all five regions. Bracketed, seasonal. No easy round. That is the point of a grand tournament.
npcs.speaker: Tournament keeper, between rounds

entries.sprites: tournament arena, Tiny City CC0 restyled

post: You belong. The Hall is yours, all five times over. Now go play. The world is open.
pre: I am not a region champion. I am the champion of the whole world. Show me why you belong in the Hall with me.
champion.speaker: MYTHAR (canon name, roster #331)

entries.kind: true final, Iridescence Plateau final ascent
entries.music: final loop, full, CC0 chiptune; ending loop, calm, CC0 chiptune

lines: Final ascent. This is not a region champion. This is the champion of the whole world. Walk it like it is the last walk, because it is.
npcs.speaker: Plateau attendant, final ascent

lines: Five regions, five Halls, one Ranger. The Mainframe remembers you now, the way it remembers Mythar. That is the true ending, and it is not an ending. It is an opening.
npcs.speaker: Prof. Aeon, after Mythar

entries.sprites: final Plateau, Furniture Kit CC0 restyled + Tiny City CC0 restyled
